editorial.thesis: A motor-trade-and-banking city of about 562,000. Its retail is heavy on banks & atms and apparel, footwear & jewellery, and thin on fitness & wellness and desserts, sweets & ice cream — and 29% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 23% of Patna's. 2.67 chain outlets per lakh residents against 11.58 in Patna; 12 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by V-Mart 2, Raymond 2, Titan 2.

The mapped economy leans to automotive. Shares of all mapped places: automotive 5.6% (Patna 2.9%); banks & finance 8.6% (Patna 6.4%); hotels & stays 2.9% (Patna 5.7%); leisure & entertainment 2.3% (Patna 3.4%). Raw counts would mislead because Patna is mapped more completely (22,868 places against 1,596), so we compare mix, not counts.
Supply and demand are misaligned. 2 zones hold 29% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Indarea alone has about 101,000 residents and 6 mapped food & drink places.
Retail is more concentrated than in Patna. 54% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Patna 49%). The largest cores are Rambhadra (606 places) and Indarea (81).

The widest brand gaps against Patna. Domino's 1 outlets vs 48; Raymond 2 outlets vs 36; Bata 1 outlets vs 33. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 6 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Patna, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Rambhadra and Indarea are the largest zones by residents (281,000 and 101,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 54% of all commercial places, and Rambhadra alone lists 606.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Rambhadra holds 14 of the 15 tracked chain outlets, and Indarea adds 0.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Rambhadra and Indarea lead on education places (144 and 27, with 50 and 7 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Indarea and Anzanpeer Chok. The blue cores include Rambhadra.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (22,868 places in Patna against 1,596 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Patna; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Patna, Hajipur's mapped places over-index on automotive (5.6% vs 2.9%), banks & finance (8.6% vs 6.4%), education (17.4% vs 15.5%) and under-index on hotels & stays (2.9% vs 5.7%), leisure & entertainment (2.3% vs 3.4%), services & crafts (5.5% vs 6.9%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 15 outlets of 12 tracked national brands within 6 km — 2.67 per lakh residents against Patna's 11.58 (342 outlets of 33 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Patna are Domino's (1 vs 48); Raymond (2 vs 36); Bata (1 vs 33). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Patna's, so low means thin by Patna's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 6 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Hajipur's age mix against Patna: children (0–14) 34.1% vs 31.5%, 15–24 17.5% vs 18.2%, working age 39.9% vs 42.5%, 60+ 8.5% vs 7.8%. Under-25s are 52% of residents.

zones.844101: A student-and-family belt: 144 education places (50 coaching) and 103 healthcare places for about 281,000 residents, with 47 food & drink places and 14 chain outlets.
zones.844102: An under-served zone: about 101,000 residents, 81 mapped places, 6 food & drink and 0 chain outlets. Depth index 43.
zones.844103: An under-served zone: about 17,000 residents, 6 mapped places, 0 food & drink and 0 chain outlets. Depth index 19.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 3.6% of mapped places against 4.3% in Patna — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 1 (Patna 48). No mapped outlet in either city: Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 1.6% of mapped places against 1.8% in Patna, so the mix is level. No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Point, Blue Tokai, Third Wave Coffee.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.4% of mapped places against 0.7% in Patna — below its share. No mapped outlet in either city: Havmor, Naturals, Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.8% of mapped places against 2.0% in Patna — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Smart / Fresh 1 (Patna 8), Big Bazaar 1 (Patna 5), Vishal Mega Mart 1 (Patna 4). No mapped outlet in either city: More, Spencer's, Easyday, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 2.2% of mapped places against 2.2% in Patna, so the mix is level. No mapped outlet in either city: MedPlus, Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 6.1% of mapped places against 5.5% in Patna — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: V-Mart 2 (Patna 17), Raymond 2 (Patna 36), Titan 2 (Patna 17), Pantaloons 1 (Patna 4). No mapped outlet in either city: Max Fashion.
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 8.7% of mapped places against 6.4% in Patna — above its share.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 4.8% of mapped places against 5.3% in Patna, so the mix is level.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 2.3% of mapped places against 4.0% in Patna — below its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
